title: The People v Evelyn Mwansa and Ors (APPEAL No.12/2020; APPEAL No.13/2020; APPEAL No.14/2020) [2024] ZMSC 18 (16 May 2024)
case_name: The People v Evelyn Mwansa and Ors
case_number: APPEAL No.12/2020; APPEAL No.13/2020; APPEAL No.14/2020
outcome_detail: DPP's appeal allowed: the finding of extenuating circumstances by the trial court was made without any basis, leading to a totally inadequate six-year sentence and a substantial miscarriage of justice. The Court of Appeal's affirmation of that finding was overturned. The Supreme Court quashed the six-year sentence imposed at first instance and substituted the mandatory sentence of death on each respondent, as required by the law applicable at the time of the offence; the fact that the respondents had since served the inadequate sentence did not bar correction.
